Stage order for lpc-crops columns: root crops = empty mound, sprout, small, medium, ripe; leafy crops = borrowed mound + 4 growth frames; fruiting plants = sprout, small, grown plant without fruit (frame 5), unripe fruit, ripe. Stand-ins are noted per entry; recolor only touches the produce/leaf colours listed.
